parts.title: Bopælskrav for udlændinge ved danske mesterskaber
Deltagelse i danske mesterskaber for løftere der repræsenterer en anden nation

ops.reason: The rule holds the residence requirement for foreigners (24 months, later 6 months) and a separate ban on lifters who represent another nation taking part in DM/JM/SM or setting records. These are two different requirements, and each needs its own version in force.
